title: Immaculate Constellation answers to the National Security Council

tellings.quote: When it comes to immaculate constellation, it appears that the Cognizant authority uh the ultimate like uh where the buck stops is in the is in the National Security Council

plain: A former Pentagon official turned whistleblower named Matthew Brown says that a secret programme called Immaculate Constellation answers in the end to the National Security Council, the White House body that advises the president on security. In his words, it "appears that the cognizant authority," the place where the buck stops, is in that council. If so, oversight of the programme would sit at the very top of government.
